gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at TAI WO INTERCHANGE and running south south-easterly for about 340 metres where it temporarily terminates as shown coloured light-pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R89A. (It should be noted that there is a future extension of this road).
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由大窩交滙處起，向東南偏南伸展約三百四十米而暫時終止，如圖則第 NTA/TW/R89A 號以淺粉紅色黑斜綫所示。(註：此路將予擴建)

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Drive commencing at its junction with WAH KING HILL ROAD and running north north-easterly for about 50 metres then curving to run north-westerly for about 125 metres where it terminates as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R89A.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此徑由與華景山路交界處起，向東北偏北伸展約五十米，再轉向西北伸展約一百二十五米而終止，如圖則第 NTA/TW/R89A 號以粉紅色黑斜綫所示。
